texto: # Output format

encabezado: Output format
texto: When you return the prompt, structure it like this:

encabezado: Output format
texto:
```
Model: <nano-banana-2 | nano-banana-pro | gpt-image-2>
Quality: <low | medium | high>          (only for gpt-image-2)
Size / Ratio: <e.g. 1536×1024 or 16:9>

Prompt:
<the prompt text, ready to copy>

Notes:
- <anything you inferred or assumed because the user did not specify>
```

encabezado: Output format
texto: For edits, also include an explicit preserve-list (mandatory for gpt-image-2, recommended for nano-banana):

encabezado: Output format
texto:
```
Change: <one concrete thing>
Preserve: <face, pose, lighting, framing, geometry, ...>
Constraints: <no extra objects, no drift, ...>
```

texto: # Final response style

encabezado: Final response style
texto: Prefer: ready-to-copy prompts, hex colors, concrete materials, named compositions, model-specific syntax (5-slot for GPT Image, natural prose for Nano Banana).

encabezado: Final response style
texto: Avoid: tag soup ("cool, modern, 4k"), vague praise ("stunning, epic, masterpiece" — actively hurts GPT Image 2), negative framing ("no people, no cars" — invert to positive), external comparisons ("like Apple ad" — describe the visual properties instead), numerical lens parameters in Nano Banana prompts (it ignores them).

texto: # GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules
texto: Production default OpenAI: `gpt-image-2`. Migration-only: `gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-1`. Бюджетный: `gpt-image-1-mini`.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Структура промпта — 5 slots
texto: ## Структура промпта — 5 slots

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Структура промпта — 5 slots
texto: GPT Image 2 сильнее всего реагирует на разделение по секциям. Пиши лейблами, не сплошным текстом.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Структура промпта — 5 slots
texto:
```
Scene: location, time of day, background, environment
Subject: primary focus — who or what is central
Important Details: materials, textures, lighting, camera angle, mood, composition
Use Case: editorial, product mockup, UI, poster, infographic
Constraints: what must NOT change/appear (no watermarks, preserve face, no extra text)
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Структура промпта — 5 slots
texto: > «The fifth slot is where most mediocre prompts fail silently.» Без явных constraints модель дрейфует.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Структура промпта — 5 slots › Минимальный пример
texto: ### Минимальный пример

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Структура промпта — 5 slots › Минимальный пример
texto:
```
Scene: small Lisbon florist storefront at blue hour, wet cobblestones
Subject: woman in navy apron locking the front door, half-turned to camera
Important Details: warm interior glow spilling onto pavement, 50mm feel,
  soft contact shadows, brushed brass door handle, "Florista" hand-painted sign
Use Case: editorial photography
Constraints: no extra signage, no people in background, no text other than the sign
```

Choose GPT Image when the brief requires precise scene composition, multiple objects, or accurate text rendering.

texto: ## Pitfalls to avoid

encabezado: Adapter: GPT Image (1.5 / 2) › Pitfalls to avoid
texto: - **Don't write Midjourney-style comma stacks**. GPT Image parses them as a list of disconnected concepts

encabezado: Adapter: GPT Image (1.5 / 2) › Pitfalls to avoid
texto: - **Don't omit spatial language when the shot has specific composition**, you're paying for the model's strength; use it

encabezado: Adapter: GPT Image (1.5 / 2) › Pitfalls to avoid
texto: - **Don't pile too many objects**, five or fewer distinct elements per scene; more degrades fidelity

encabezado: Adapter: GPT Image (1.5 / 2) › Pitfalls to avoid
texto: - **Don't include `--ar` flags or weight syntax**. GPT Image ignores them

encabezado: Adapter: GPT Image (1.5 / 2) › Pitfalls to avoid
texto: - **Don't forget that GPT Image's "AI look" is real**, the closing "natural skin texture, no AI rendering artifacts" line meaningfully helps but isn't a complete fix. For pure photoreal, Flux is still stronger
